subject: owl designed by Claude

subject: flex hoses and chains

caption: Chains and hoses that bend to fit.

subject: Brick Art dialog
alt: The Build this picture dialog with Brick Art selected: a preview of a blue spiral galaxy mosaic above sliders set to 3 by 3 panels and 3 plates deep, five ticked options, a field to tell Claude how to plan it, and a count of 1,510 parts for a picture 48 by 48 studs, with Cancel and Build it buttons.
caption: Turn a picture into a Brick Art mosaic.

subject: studio render
alt: A studio render of a grey stone LEGO® castle on a plain white backdrop: crenellated walls and square towers flying red pennants, an arched gateway, a timber-topped watchtower and a courtyard with a red canopy, on a green baseplate edged by a blue moat.
caption: A castle, rendered in the built-in studio.

subject: building instructions booklet
alt: A page of building instructions on a pale blue background showing steps 5 to 8 of a red car with a blue seat: each step has a box listing the parts it adds beside a drawing of the car so far, and a progress bar and page number 3 run along the bottom.
caption: Printable instructions, step by step, with parts lists.

subject: share page
alt: The Brickworks share page for a model called Share Flow Car, 61 parts, by Flow Builder: a red car with a black roof and clear windscreen on a green baseplate, with Steps, Booklet, Parts list and Open in Brickworks buttons at the top and a step slider at step 16 of 16 along the bottom.
caption: Share a link; anyone can open the model in 3D.

subject: collection
alt: The My collection dialog on its What can I build? tab: 343 models ranked by how many of their pieces you own, from an example car at 39 percent and a bench at 14 percent down to official sets such as Gear Grinders, Forestmen’s Crossing and Dragon Defender at around 10 percent, each with an Open link.
caption: See what you can build from the bricks you own.

subject: app (hero)
alt: The Brickworks builder with the Tower of Orthanc open: a tall black tower of 9,429 bricks rising to curved horns on a green baseplate in the centre, the parts bin and colours on the left, and the Design with Claude panel on the right.
caption: The Brickworks builder with the Tower of Orthanc open.

subject: castle designed by Claude
alt: A grey stone LEGO® castle on a green baseplate ringed by a blue moat: crenellated walls and square towers flying red pennants, one tower under a timber roof, an arched gateway and a paved courtyard inside.

subject: Orthanc, front corner
alt: The Tower of Orthanc in black LEGO® bricks seen from a front corner: a tall tower of clustered piers banded with grey courses, rising to sharp curved horns, on a stepped plinth on a green baseplate.
caption: Orthanc from the front corner.

subject: Orthanc, open back
alt: The back of the same black tower, open down a narrow slot between two piers to show furnished floors stacked one above another, with two figures on the summit between the horns.
caption: From the back: the furnished floors inside.

subject: pose and animate
alt: The Pose and animate panel beside the model: sliders for a turret on its turntable and an arm on its hinge, a key at 0 seconds, and the animation's frame rate and size; on the baseplate a red Technic chain round two sprockets, a red hose curving between two bricks, and a red plate on a hinge.
caption: A slider for every joint, and keys made an animation.
